parameters.content:
## Dispatcher (scalable)

Fetches the repo inventory (GitHub org, internal URL, or static list) and
writes **chunked job files** to a shared run volume (`RUN_ROOT`).

Workers (`01-worker-*`) pull chunks from the same volume, so any number of
worker instances can run in parallel (queue mode, replicas, multiple hosts on
NFS). This decouples 'fetch the list' from 'do the work'.

Env knobs: GITHUB_ORG, GITHUB_TOKEN, REPO_LIST_URL, PIPELINES, CHUNK_SIZE,
MULTITOOL_ROOT, RUN_ROOT.

parameters.command: RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.RUN_ROOT || '' }}"; if [ -z "$RUN_ROOT" ]; then RUN_ROOT="{{ $env.MULTITOOL_ROOT || '/opt/multi-tool' }}/n8n/runs"; fi; mkdir -p "{{ $json.jobDir }}" "$RUN_ROOT/manifests"; echo '{{ $json.jobBase64 }}' | base64 -d > "{{ $json.jobFile }}"; echo "{{ $json.chunkId }} {{ $json.repoCount }}" >> "{{ $json.manifestFile }}"; echo "dispatched {{ $json.chunkId }}"
